role: Independent training-gaps research contributor; not the Amalgam integration owner.
objective: Freeze and qualify a genuinely converged, cross-platform-stable, fully trained conventional rank-4 ALS/full-refit comparator; WSP211 Adam plateau failure and OS disagreement are preserved as failed controls and not replayed.
hypothesis: Exact rank4 coordinate normal-equation full-refit on fixed source-free low-rank data can reach the unchanged 3-check objective plateau at every B0–B3 stage without cross-platform metric divergence.

cohort.generator: Independent integer-valued SHA256 factor components from WSP212|seed|allele|position|dimension, component ((int(SHA256)[0] mod 7)-3)/3; synthetic target = dot of same-allele latent vectors; neither trained arm receives factors, generator features, test targets, or held labels as fit information.
cohort.split: Existing WSP200 canonical whole pair groups; FIT B0-B3 only used for fits; PUBLIC_DEV generated only after all four stages converge; VALID and RESERVED never computed.

algorithm.initialization: Unmodified WSP200 hash-signed 0.01 rank4 initialization, identical across arms
algorithm.refit: Unmodified WSP200 rank4 exact coordinate normal-equation solve and full-fit cumulative evidence; 8 ordinary sweeps per check, 100 checks maximum per stage = 800 sweeps cap
algorithm.convergence: Three consecutive relative objective decreases in [0, 1e-6], with objective increases beyond 1e-9 hard fail. No tuning after cohort access.
controls: Standardized zero-interaction predictor, without fitted parameters
Inherited WSP200 blocked full_refit conventional ALS; no Adam replay or WSP210/211 primary results
algorithm.data_access: FIT stage samples are cumulative; B0 historical samples remain frozen for retention measurement. Negative control does not fit.

metrics: Per-stage stage/rows/unique sample and group receipts, exact elapsed wall ns, actual sweeps/solve count, objective and B0 retention MSE
Exact within-OS checkpoint bytes / SHA256 / all B0 prediction parity after cold restore
Held PUBLIC_DEV pair-group RMSE for trained comparator versus standardized zero control, only if all stages converged
Per-stage platform-neutral normalized MSE/objective and held RMSE; cross-OS automated numeric comparison at abs 1e-8, relative 1e-8, not bitwise checkpoint equality
No FIT/PUBLIC_DEV group overlap, no forbidden dataset access, no source first use, source receipt

outcome_rules.engineering_pass: Both OS source-pinned mandatory root+WSP200+WSP209+WSP210 smoke+WSP211 regression+WSP212 regression plus G29 and clean checkout; independent cross-OS parity check passes.
outcome_rules.control_qualified: All four new worlds finish B0-B3, each stage passes plateau within 800 actual sweeps, per-OS cold restore byte-equivalent and prediction parity; finite metrics; platform-normalized metrics agree within frozen 1e-8 abs/relative bound. No use of withheld labels before fit completes.
outcome_rules.control_unqualified: Any failure of convergence, metric parity, source fence, cold restore, or stage integrity; reject results, preserve evidence without seed reuse/retuning.
outcome_rules.learning_diagnostic: Report zero-vs-full-refit held RMSE and B0 retention without enforcing a post hoc threshold; source-free control qualification is not evidence for direct-weight superiority or native intelligence.
outcome_rules.next_on_pass: Only subsequently freeze and evaluate a fully disjoint source-free direct-weight-vs-qualified-conventional comparison, with matched info/actions/compute and genuine held transfer; separately authorize protected original first use.
outcome_rules.next_on_fail: Preserve negative calibration; do not rerun/tune 21201-21204.

platform.workflows: Auto PR workflow for exact candidate, source-only, no new scheduler/owner controller.
